title: kbfacts.parse_tag does not split a '; S-b, S-c: path' part, so a list of sources after the semicolon stays in the note uncited
goal: parse_tag reads a kind-less part after a ';' that holds a list of source ids before its colon ([CODE S-a: p#x; S-b, S-c: q#y]) as further sources of the part before it, as it reads a single id there: the repro exits 0, and lint.py and rag.py eval stay at errors=0 and all rows passing

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbfacts;p=kbfacts.parse_tag('[CODE S-sipjyeoi: a.go#x; S-gfjnysog, S-aaaaaaaa: b.go#y]');ids=[i for x in p for i in x['ids']];print('ids parsed:',ids);sys.exit(0 if {'S-gfjnysog','S-aaaaaaaa'}<=set(ids) else 1)
